rationale.consistency: Uses existing idioms: CommandModifier/WithRepoDir, FlagErrorf blank check mirroring pr checkout, MutuallyExclusive chain, git client methods returning cmd.Output() error like WorktreeRemove.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers blank flag, --list/--checkout conflicts, relative->absolute, symlink/non-dir leaf, reuse of existing linked worktree, same-repo/other-repo targets, and warns on failed ff-only pull; validates path before creating the remote branch.
rationale.scope: Core feature and shared-package move are as asked, but pr checkout gets an extra refactor: new WorktreeCheckoutCommands helper, removal of worktreeCheckoutCmds, and swapping localBranchExists (show-ref) for HasLocalBranch, altering that command's git calls.
rationale.readability: Clear names (WorktreeTarget.Path/Reuse), focused checkoutBranchInWorktree, doc comments explain non-obvious git behaviour; pointer-vs-value WorktreeTarget between commands is a minor wrinkle.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagated everywhere, no panics; best-effort rev-parse fallback preserved; double filepath.Abs is harmless; pull failure degrades to a warning as in existing flow.
rationale.maintainability: Two parallel ways to express the same worktree add commands (shared command slices for pr checkout vs git client methods for develop), so future changes must be made in both; cmdsForMissingRemote still hand-rolls worktree add.
